summary: Iteration 2: Admin 'إدارة الحسابات' feature + regression. Backend: 26/26 pytest pass (updated test_tms_api.py to driver_id vehicle payload; new test_accounts_api.py covering create student/driver + login, gender/university required, password required on create, duplicate phone 400 (incl. admin phone), edit keeps old password when empty / new password works / old phone stops working, role change 400, edit to existing phone 400, rejected status blocks login (403) and invalidates existing token (401), reactivate, /register request -> pending -> approve/reject, vehicle linked to driver_id, driver name/phone edit syncs to vehicle and driver still sees trips with new phone, delete linked driver 400, delete account 200 then 404, admin not listed/deletable via /accounts, student/driver 403 and anon 401 on /accounts). Lockout: 5x401 then 429 now works (fixed). bcrypt $2b$. Frontend (Playwright): nav-accounts present (Students tab removed), create student -> appears in الطلاب, duplicate phone toast, create driver from السائقون (no gender/university fields) -> 'غير مرتبط بسيارة', vehicle form driver select lists driver accounts, add + edit vehicle (select prefilled), driver row then shows plate, delete linked driver shows error toast, edit student name with empty password keeps login, suspend via status select -> موقوفة tab -> login blocked toast -> تفعيل reactivates -> login to /student works, driver logs in to /driver and sees trip of vehicle, /register request shows in طلبات جديدة -> تفعيل moves to الطلاب, delete account via UI. All admin tabs load with no page errors; mobile layout OK. All passed.

minor.issue: driver_fields() accepts any driver regardless of status - a rejected/pending driver can be assigned to a vehicle.
Deleting a student leaves their bookings with dangling student_id (bookings still dispatched/visible). Consider cancelling or blocking.
Admin-created accounts allow 4-char passwords while /auth/register requires 6 - inconsistent policy.

Vehicles store driver_id but linkage (driver_vehicle_ids, accounts.vehicles, delete guard, sync) is keyed on driver_phone. Works because update syncs phone, but driver_id should be the source of truth to avoid drift (e.g. legacy vehicles without driver_id).

issues: Suspended accounts show badge 'مرفوض' (rejected) - wording suits rejected requests, not admin-suspended accounts
No quick 'إيقاف' button on active rows; suspension only possible via edit dialog status select
Driver accounts can be set to 'pending' but pending drivers do not appear in طلبات جديدة (tab is student-only) - only in السائقون
University picker still has '+ جديد' toggle although backend no longer adds universities on register (free text saved on user only) - fine but may confuse

action_items: Optional: in driver_fields require driver status == 'active'
Optional: use driver_id (not driver_phone) for vehicle linkage lookups
Optional: handle bookings when deleting a student account; unify min password length
Optional UX: add 'إيقاف' action on active rows and label suspended status as 'موقوف'
critical_code_review_comments: Accounts endpoints properly admin-only, exclude _id/password_hash, validate via Pydantic, return 400/404 with Arabic messages.
current_user rejects non-active users, so suspension takes effect immediately on existing tokens - good.

AccountRow.setStatus PUTs the whole account object (extra fields ignored by Pydantic) - works but sending only needed fields is cleaner; a PATCH status endpoint would avoid re-validating gender/university for legacy records missing them (would 400).
Legacy /api/students endpoints still present but unused by new UI.
